author: reek
body: What this test can and cannot see is worth stating, because it decides what it is for. A correct optimizer does not change any answer, so nothing below can tell whether a definition was inlined -- run it with the pass off and every line is identical. It is not a firing test and must not be read as one; that evidence is the emitted symbol map, where an inlined definition is absent and a declined one is present.

author: reek
body: `free` and `shadowed` need separate helpers with identical bodies, and that is not duplication for its own sake: one helper called from both sites would have two references, both sites would be declined for that reason alone, and the capture guard would never be reached. Each has to be a single-caller definition to put the guard under load.

author: reek
body: A wrong answer here is 8 on the last line. That is the capture bug this pass is most likely to grow, and it is the reason the pair exists.
